Questions

Do my reps need to install anything?

No. They open vpexdialer.com on their phone, sign in and tap to call. They can add it to their home screen like an app.

Do we need to buy phone lines?

No. Calls go out from each rep's own phone, so there's nothing to set up and no shared numbers to get flagged.

What does it cost?

$49 per rep, per month. Every active login counts as a rep. 7 days free with no card to start, and you can cancel any time.

What happens when a rep leaves?

Turn their access off in Team & access. They're signed out within seconds and your bill drops by itself.

Can I bring my own lead lists?

Yes. Upload Excel, CSV, text or contacts, or paste a list. Numbers already in your list, or on your Do Not Call list, are skipped.

Does it work for my industry?

VPEX has versions for insurance, real estate, business funding, auto and solar, each in your floor's own words. Try the demo office for yours above.

Can I see what my reps are doing?

Yes. A live scoreboard, a daily recap, answer times by hour, and a sales coach that shows who needs help.

Goals & calling

Every lead shows their local time. Anyone outside their state’s calling hours is flagged in red, and tapping Call asks before it dials: 8 AM–9 PM under federal rules, and stricter in 20 states, such as Florida (8 AM–8 PM), Texas (from noon on Sundays) and Pennsylvania (9 AM–7 PM, never on Sundays). Florida, Maryland, Oklahoma and Oregon also allow only 3 sales calls to one person in 24 hours. Based on published state rules as of October 2026. Not legal advice.

Follow-up texts

After a missed call or an interested lead, a ready-to-send text pops up. One tap opens Messages; you tap Send. Offered only during their state’s calling hours, and missed-call texts go once per lead.

Fill-ins: {first} first name · {name} full name · {me} your name · {company} your company · {next} their scheduled follow-up time · {when} the appointment time · {closer} who they’re meeting.
